result.title: U-Statistics-Powered LLM Reasoning
result.summary: Since its introduction by DeepSeek, group relative policy optimization (GRPO) has been widely adopted for training large reasoning models and agents, spurring a proliferation of its variants. Yet the group size, a crucial hyperparameter in these GRPO-type algorithms, remains largely chosen by trial and error. Exploiting the U-statistic structure of GRPO's policy gradient, we recast the selection of the group size as a classical statistical problem of variance ratio estimation. This problem is particularly challenging when the denominator of the ratio is small, rendering naive plug-in estimators unstable. To address this challenge, we propose a pessimistic ratio estimator that accounts for the denominator's estimation uncertainty. We characterise the statistical properties of this estimator across three sample-size regimes. Empirically, using %a jackknife-based pessimistic rule on synthetic tasks from Reasoning Gym and real-world benchmarks covering both mathematical reasoning and code generation, we show that our adaptive group size selection reduces the mean squared error of the resulting policy gradient and improves policy optimisation over fixed-group-size baselines, with modest additional computational cost.

AI.brief_summary: 该文把 GRPO 策略梯度的 U 统计量结构用于组大小这一超参数的选择，将其转化为方差比估计问题，并提出对分母不确定性保守的比值估计器，在合成任务与数学、代码基准上自适应选择组大小以降低策略梯度 MSE。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 RL 训练优化，与视觉推理主线不直接相关；但其按估计不确定性自适应分配采样预算/组规模的思路，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 类的计算预算与停止决策、以及奖励贡献分配提供可核查的统计线索。
